preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.currencyInvalid: Currency must be a 3-letter ISO code (e.g. EUR, QAR, USD).
preferences.noShowGrace: No-show grace must be at least 5 minutes.
preferences.currencyHelp: Currency used across the POS (tickets, reports, receipts). Use a 3-letter ISO code like EUR, QAR, USD.
preferences.languagesHelp: Default UI language for this venue. Applies to waiter, admin, and reservations screens.
preferences.approvalsHelp: Require an ADMIN PIN to approve sensitive actions on waiter terminals.
preferences.requirePinDiscountHelp: Any discount at payment requires approval.
preferences.requirePinService: Require manager PIN to remove service charge
preferences.requirePinServiceHelp: Removing service charge on a ticket requires approval.
preferences.autoCloseHelp: Automatically close a waiter's shift if it stays open for too long. Shifts are only auto-closed when the waiter has no open tickets — open tickets always block the auto-close.
preferences.autoCloseEnableHelp: Runs in the background every 15 minutes.
preferences.autoNoShowHelp: Automatically mark a BOOKED reservation as NO SHOW after a grace period past its start time. Frees the table on the reservation floor while keeping the record on the List view. Only affects reservations that haven't been seated, cancelled or completed.
preferences.autoNoShowEnableHelp: Runs in the background every minute.
preferences.serviceChargeHelp: Adds an automatic service charge to the bill. Waiters can remove it per ticket.

fiscal.title: Fiskalizimi
fiscal.enableHelp: When enabled, payment receipts are submitted to certified fiscal middleware before printing, and VAT is added on tickets and in admin statistics. When disabled, receipts print normally with no VAT on prices.
fiscal.middlewareHelp: Use the easyPos cloud URL from Postman, or a local desktop API URL.
fiscal.baseUrlRequired: Base URL is required when fiskalizimi is enabled.
fiscal.authTokenRequired: Access token is required when fiskalizimi is enabled.
fiscal.authTokenConfigured: Token saved — enter a new value to replace
fiscal.authTokenStored: Access token is saved on this device. Leave blank to keep it — to replace it, paste a fresh token from Postman and Save.
fiscal.tokenHint: Saved token ends …{{suffix}} · tokenId …{{tokenId}} · device …{{deviceTail}} — compare with Postman Variables.
fiscal.tokenResyncHelp: Article and unit must match your easyPos catalog. Postman minimal uses PROD001 + soldIn XPP.
fiscal.integrationAppRequired: Integration app ID is required for easyPos cloud API.
fiscal.operatorIdRequired: Operator code is required for easyPos cloud API.
fiscal.operatorIdTypo: Operator looks wrong: use gh537ez280 (from your verified invoice), not gh537ez200.
fiscal.operatorIdHelp: From Postman or the successful invoice JSON (operatorCode field).
fiscal.defaultSoldInHelp: Must match Postman Register Invoice (Minimal) — for your demo account use XPP, not cope.
fiscal.cloudFallbackArticleIdHelp: For demo: set PROD001 from Postman so every line uses a known easyPos article.
fiscal.eurExchangeRateHelp: Required if POS currency is EUR (e.g. 100.5 ALL per 1 EUR).
fiscal.testMinimalNeedsToken: Paste the full accessToken from Postman Variables into Access token first, then click Test minimal invoice again. Leaving the field blank keeps the old saved token (…{{suffix}}), which does not match Postman.
fiscal.testMinimalUnavailable: Restart the POS app, then try again (fiscal test handler not loaded).
fiscal.testOkCloudAuth: Connected and authenticated. Token, URL, and integration app are correct. docId is generated automatically when you take a payment.
fiscal.testFailed: Could not connect to fiscal middleware.
fiscal.reviewHelp: These sales need someone to open easyPos. Either we could not confirm the invoice was registered, or it was registered and the ticket was voided afterwards. Handle each one there, then say what you did.
fiscal.reviewCorrectionHelp: This sale was already declared to the tax service and then voided, so the invoice above no longer matches what happened. Issue a corrective invoice in easyPos, then mark it done.
fiscal.reviewFoundHelp: The invoice exists. The sale will be recorded with these numbers and never sent again.
fiscal.reviewNotFoundHelp: No invoice exists. The payment will be sent again.

googleCalendar.title: Google Calendar reservations
googleCalendar.subtitle: Import confirmed bookings from Google Calendar into the POS reservations screen. Tables are never assigned automatically — staff assign them manually.
googleCalendar.flowHelp:
WhatsApp agent → confirms booking → creates Google Calendar event → POS syncs automatically.

Click Connect to Google Calendar, sign in in your browser, then choose which calendar receives WhatsApp bookings.
googleCalendar.connectHelp: Opens your browser so you can sign in with the Google account that receives WhatsApp bookings.
googleCalendar.oauthNotConfigured: Google sign-in is not configured for this POS build yet. Ask your provider to add GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.
googleCalendar.eventFormatTitle: Recommended event format for your WhatsApp bot
googleCalendar.eventFormatExample:
Title: Guest Name (4)
Description:
phone: +355691234567
party: 4
area: Terrace
note: Birthday — staff assign the table in POS

kdsSettings.title: Kitchen Display (KDS)
kdsSettings.masterHelp: Turn this off if the kitchen works from printed tickets only. Orders still print; nothing is sent to KDS screens.

kdsSettings.stationsHelp: Turn a station off to stop routing its items to any kitchen screen. Disabled stations keep printing on receipts but never appear on the KDS.
kdsSettings.openWindowDisabled: Turn Kitchen Display on to open a kitchen screen from here.
kdsSettings.updatesHelp: KDS app updates are installed on each kitchen screen (not from this POS admin panel). When a new KDS version is published, the kitchen app shows a download prompt — use Install & Restart there, same as POS updates under System Updates.
kdsSettings.chooseStationHelp: On each kitchen screen, open the KDS Settings tab (or press J on the bump bar) to choose {{kitchen}}, {{bar}}, or {{dessert}} for that display.
kdsSettings.stationDisabled: {{station}} disabled — orders no longer route here.
kdsSettings.bumpHelp: Program each physical key in PrehKeyTec WinProgrammer (or MapMyKey) to send the keystroke below. USB plug-and-play — no driver needed on the KDS PC.

adminLan.hostRunningTitle: Tablets stay connected in the background
adminLan.hostRunningBody: On the installed POS, closing this window does not stop the app. It keeps running in the menu bar (Mac) or system tray (Windows) so iPads and tablets can still take orders. Open it again from that icon. Choose Quit on the icon to stop — tablets will disconnect until the POS is opened on this computer.
adminLan.openAtLogin: Start automatically when this computer starts
adminLan.openAtLoginHint: Opens in the background at sign-in so tablets work even if nobody opens the till screen. Turn this off if you do not want the POS to launch by itself.
adminLan.title: LAN / Tablets
adminLan.allowBrowserHelp: Lets waiters open the POS from a browser on the same network (tablet/phone web browsers, laptops). The installed POS app on iOS/Android always works regardless of this toggle. Takes effect immediately after saving — already-connected browsers will lose access on their next request.
adminLan.requirePairingHelp: Tablet / phone logins (browser and native app) must enter the pairing code shown below.
adminLan.browserDisabled: Browser access is disabled. The desktop app and the installed iOS / Android POS app can still connect. Enable “Allow browser access” above to let waiters open the POS from a regular web browser too.
adminLan.pairingHint: Use this code on tablets when logging in.
adminLan.setupHint: Use this on each tablet once. It saves this venue's IP, ports, and pairing code in the browser so staff don't re-enter them after restarting the POS or reopening the app (same device & browser).
adminLan.noWifi: No Wi‑Fi IP detected. Connect this Mac to Wi‑Fi or Ethernet and reopen this page.
